item.title: Move Over Butter Rice Cakes, the Purple Trend ‘Ube’ Has Arrived (버터떡 비켜라, 보랏빛 바람 ‘우베’가 왔다)
item.description:
Recently, interest in ‘ube,’ known for its vivid purple color, has surged on global social media platforms, prompting domestic coffee franchise companies and convenience store chains to rush out related products. This follows the recent trends of matcha, Dubai chewy cookies, and butter rice cakes, as businesses aim to seize the next wave. (최근 글로벌 사회관계망서비스(SNS)를 중심으로 선명한 보랏빛을 내세운 ‘우베’에 대한 관심이 높아지면서, 국내 커피 프랜차이즈 기업과 편의점 업계과 앞다퉈 관련 상품을 출시하고 있다. 최근 유행했던 말차, 두바이 쫀득 쿠키(두쫀쿠), 버터떡에 이어 새로운 흐름을 선점하려는 것이다.)

BGF Retail, which operates the CU convenience store chain, announced on the 27th that it will introduce six new products incorporating ube, including ‘Ube Basque Cheesecake,’ ‘Yonsei Milk Ube Cream Bread,’ and ‘Ube Roll.’ Ube is a purple yam ingredient commonly used in Southeast Asia, characterized by a sweet taste similar to purple sweet potatoes and a nutty aroma. Most notably, its striking color has boosted visual appeal on platforms like Instagram and TikTok, leading to the spread of ube-based beverages and desserts. This is why the food and beverage industry is racing to launch ube desserts and drinks. (편의점 씨유(CU)를 운영하는 비지에프(BGF)리테일은 우베를 활용한 ‘우베 바스크 치즈케이크’, ‘연세우유 우베 생크림빵’, ‘우베 롤’ 등 신제품 6종을 선보인다고 27일 밝혔다. 우베는 동남아시아 지역에서 쓰이는 보라색 참마류 식재료로, 자색고구마와 같은 단맛과 고소한 향이 나는 것이 특징이다. 무엇보다 강렬한 색감이 인스타그램, 틱톡 등에서 시각적 주목도를 높이면서 이를 활용한 음료와 디저트류가 확산하고 있다. 식음료 업계가 앞다퉈서 우베 디저트와 음료를 출시하는 배경이다.)

Twosome Place became the first domestic franchise to launch three ube beverages and a limited-edition ‘Spoonable Ube Avac’ cake this month. Starbucks Korea began selling the ‘Ube Basque Cheesecake’ at 100 domestic stores on the 14th, and after it gained popularity, expanded sales to all nationwide stores starting from the 24th. Other chains like Paul Bassett, Knotted, and Tom N Toms have also released related menu items. (투썸플레이스는 이달 들어 국내 프랜차이즈 업계 최초로 우베 음료 3종과 ‘떠먹는 우베 아박’ 케이크를 한정 출시했다. 스타벅스 코리아는 지난 14일 국내 100개 매장에서 한정 판매한 ‘우베 바스크 치즈케이크’가 인기를 얻자 지난 24일부터는 전국 매장으로 판매를 확대했다. 이밖에 폴 바셋, 노티드, 탐앤탐스 등도 관련 메뉴를 출시했다.)

However, industry insiders view this trend as potentially short-lived. Just as products like Dubai chewy cookies and butter rice cakes, which gained fame through social media, were quickly replaced, interest in ube could also shift rapidly. (다만 업계에서는 이런 유행이 단기 유행에 그칠 수 있다고 보고 있다. 두쫀쿠, 버터떡 등 에스엔에스를 바탕으로 인기를 끌던 상품이 순식간에 교체된 것처럼, 우베를 향한 관심 역시 급변할 수 있다는 것이다.)

Jo Jun-hyung, head of BGF Retail’s snack food team, stated, “Rather than simply following trends, CU plans to introduce a variety of menus that stimulate consumer curiosity and enhance satisfaction through a creative perspective.” (조준형 비지에프리테일 스낵식품팀장은 “씨유는 단순히 유행을 따라가기보다 독창적인 시각으로 소비자들의 호기심을 자극하고 만족감을 높일 수 있는 다양한 메뉴를 선보일 예정”이라고 말했다.)

By Seo Hye-mi, Reporter ham@hani.co.kr (서혜미 기자 ham@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Professor Mosab Kaseem of Sejong University's Department of Nanoscience and Engineering Publishes Four Papers in International Journals on Cancer Treatment and Carbon Neutral Materials Research (세종대 나노신소재공학과 모삽 카심 교수, 암 치료·탄소중립 소재 연구로 국제 학술지 4편 게재)
item.description:
Professor Mosab Kaseem of the Department of Nanoscience and Engineering at Sejong University (President Um Jong-hwa) is drawing attention from the academic community by consecutively publishing research outcomes on advanced functional materials aimed at addressing global challenges such as cancer treatment and carbon neutrality in prestigious international journals. (세종대학교(총장 엄종화) 나노신소재공학과 모삽 카심(Mosab Kaseem) 교수가 암 치료와 탄소중립 등 인류가 직면한 글로벌 과제 해결을 위한 첨단 기능성 소재 연구 성과를 세계적 학술지에 연이어 발표하며 학계의 주목을 받고 있다.)

These research achievements have been recognized for their academic value through a total of four papers—two each published in the authoritative international journals 'Coordination Chemistry Reviews' and 'Advanced Composites and Hybrid Materials,' which are highly regarded in the fields of chemistry and materials science. (이번 연구 성과는 화학 및 재료과학 분야에서 권위 있는 국제 학술지인 ‘Coordination Chemistry Reviews’와 ‘Advanced Composites and Hybrid Materials’에 각각 두 편씩, 총 네 편의 논문으로 게재되며 학술적 가치를 인정받았다.)

The research featured in 'Coordination Chemistry Reviews' focused on innovative material design in the bio and energy sectors. The paper titled 'Coordination-driven design of molecularly imprinted polymer (MIP) architectures integrated with metal–organic frameworks (MOFs) for cancer therapy' proposed a structure combining molecularly imprinted polymers (MIP) with metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) for the development of precise drug delivery systems targeting cancer cells. Subsequently, the study 'Porphyrinic metal–organic frameworks (PMOFs) as catalysts in CO₂–epoxide coupling toward cyclic carbonate synthesis' addressed catalytic technology for converting carbon dioxide into useful chemicals, offering practical solutions for achieving carbon neutrality. (‘Coordination Chemistry Reviews’에 실린 연구에서는 바이오 및 에너지 분야의 혁신적 소재 설계가 핵심적으로 다뤄졌다. ‘Coordination-driven design of molecularly imprinted polymer(MIP) architectures integrated with metal–organic frameworks(MOFs) for cancer therapy’ 논문은 분자 각인 고분자(MIP)와 금속-유기 골격체(MOF)를 결합한 구조를 통해 암세포를 표적으로 하는 정밀 약물 전달 시스템 개발 가능성을 제시했다. 이어 ‘Porphyrinic metal–organic frameworks (PMOFs) as catalysts in CO₂–epoxide coupling toward cyclic carbonate synthesis’ 연구에서는 이산화탄소를 유용한 화학물질로 전환하는 촉매 기술을 다루며, 탄소중립 실현을 위한 실질적 해법을 제시했다.)

Additionally, the two papers published in 'Advanced Composites and Hybrid Materials' demonstrate potential applications in the environmental and renewable energy fields. The research 'Recent advances in photocatalytic membranes modified by quantum dots-based heterostructures' provided an in-depth analysis of next-generation purification technology that effectively decomposes water pollutants using photocatalytic membrane technologies based on quantum dot heterostructures. The paper 'Ti₃C₂-MXene quantum dot/Fe-MOF heterostructure with enhanced visible-light photocatalytic performance' proposed a hybrid nanostructure that achieves high photocatalytic performance under visible light conditions, proving its applicability in real-world environmental purification and energy systems. (또한 ‘Advanced Composites and Hybrid Materials’에 게재된 두 편의 논문은 환경 및 재생에너지 분야에서의 응용 가능성을 보여준다. ‘Recent advances in photocatalytic membranes modified by quantum dots-based heterostructures’ 연구는 양자점 기반 헤테로구조를 적용한 광촉매 막 기술을 통해 수질 오염 물질을 효과적으로 분해하는 차세대 정화 기술을 심층 분석했다. ‘Ti₃C₂-MXene quantum dot/Fe-MOF heterostructure with enhanced visible-light photocatalytic performance’ 논문에서는 가시광선 조건에서 높은 광촉매 성능을 구현한 하이브리드 나노구조를 제안하며, 실제 환경 정화 및 에너지 시스템 적용 가능성을 입증했다.)

Professor Mosab Kaseem stated, "It is meaningful to contribute to the development of Korean science and education through these research achievements," adding, "I will continue to dedicate myself to research on advanced materials that improve the quality of human life." (모삽 카심 교수는 “이번 연구 성과를 통해 한국 과학의 발전과 교육에 기여할 수 있어 뜻깊다”며 “앞으로도 인류의 삶의 질 향상에 기여하는 첨단 소재 연구에 지속적으로 매진하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

Meanwhile, Professor Mosab Kaseem recently acquired South Korean nationality after being selected as a 'Special Naturalized Citizen for Outstanding Talent' following a review by the Ministry of Justice's Nationality Review Committee. (한편, 모삽 카심 교수는 최근 법무부 국적심의위원회의 심의를 거쳐 ‘우수인재 특별귀화자’로 선정되며 대한민국 국적을 취득했다.)

'Special Naturalization for Outstanding Talent' is a system that exceptionally grants nationality to foreign talents with outstanding capabilities in fields such as science, economy, and culture, who are highly likely to contribute to South Korea. Professor Mosab Kaseem was granted nationality in recognition of his exceptional academic achievements and contributions in the fields of nanomaterials and advanced functional materials. (‘우수인재 특별귀화’는 과학·경제·문화 등의 분야에서 탁월한 역량으로 우리나라에 기여할 가능성이 높은 외국인 인재에게 예외적으로 국적을 부여하는 제도로, 모삽 카심 교수는 나노소재 및 첨단 기능성 소재 분야에서의 뛰어난 학문적 성과와 기여도를 인정받아 국적을 부여받았다.)

item.title: Kookmin University's Defense Unmanned R&D Center and GE Aerospace Co-host Technical Seminar (국민대 국방무인R&D센터, GE Aerospace와 기술 세미나 개최)
item.description:
The Defense Unmanned R&D Center, led by Professor Hong Haenam of Kookmin University's Kookmin Research Institute (President Jeong Seung-ryul), held the "2026 Kookmin University x GE Aerospace Technical Seminar" alongside GE Aerospace on Wednesday, April 22, 2026. (국민대학교(총장 정승렬) 국민연구원 홍해남 교수가 이끄는 국방무인R&D센터는 지난 2026년 4월 22일(수) GE Aerospace와 함께 ‘2026 Kookmin University x GE Aerospace Technical Seminar’를 개최했다.)

This seminar was organized to share trends in artificial intelligence (AI) and autonomy technologies for unmanned systems (UxS), as well as avionics research and development for manned-unmanned teaming (MUM-T) systems, and to strengthen industry-academia-research collaboration in related fields. (이번 세미나는 무인 시스템(UxS)의 인공지능(AI) 및 자율(Autonomy) 기술과 유·무인 복합시스템(MUM-T)의 항공전자(Avionics) 연구개발 동향을 공유하고, 관련 분야의 산·학·연 협력 체계를 강화하기 위해 마련됐다.)

Approximately 20 experts attended the event, including Kookmin University's Industry-Academic Cooperation Foundation Head (Executive Vice President for Planning) Sohn Jin-sik, faculty from the Defense Unmanned R&D Center, the Department of Electronic Engineering, and the Department of Future Mobility, as well as representatives from GE Aerospace, the Agency for Defense Development (ADD), the Civil-Military Cooperation Promotion Agency, the Korea Research Institute for Defense Technology Planning and Development (KRIT), the Republic of Korea Air Force Headquarters, and KOTRA Dallas. (행사에는 손진식 국민대 산학협력단장(기획부총장)을 비롯해 국방무인R&D센터, 전자공학부, 미래모빌리티학과 교수진 등 교내 관계자와 GE Aerospace, 국방과학연구소(ADD), 민군협력진흥원, 국방기술진흥연구소(KRIT), 공군본부, KOTRA Dallas 관계자 등 약 20명의 전문가가 참석했다.)

The seminar began with a welcome address by Head Sohn Jin-sik, followed by a presentation on GE Aerospace's avionics systems and MOSA (Modular Open Systems Approach) technology, an introduction to case studies from the Agency for Defense Development and the Korea Research Institute for Defense Technology Planning and Development, and research presentations by Professor Jang Young-min of Kookmin University's Department of Electronic Engineering and Professor Lee Soo-won of Kookmin University's Department of Future Mobility. During the subsequent discussion, participants exchanged views centered on technology trends and collaboration opportunities, deliberating on future directions for cooperation. (세미나는 손진식 단장의 환영사를 시작으로 GE Aerospace의 항공전자 시스템 및 MOSA(개방형 시스템 아키텍처) 기술 발표, 국방과학연구소와 국방기술진흥연구소의 업무 사례 소개, 장영민 국민대 전자공학부 교수와 이수원 국민대 미래모빌리티학과 교수의 연구 발표 순으로 진행됐다. 이어진 토의에서는 참석자들이 기술 동향과 협력 가능성을 중심으로 의견을 나누며 향후 협력 방향을 논의했다.)

Since signing a research cooperation MOU related to unmanned aerial vehicle systems with GE Aerospace in 2018, Kookmin University has maintained close collaborative ties. Notably, from 2021 to 2024, the two entities carried out a joint project on developing an integrated quantum-secure avionics suite, accumulating a foundation for collaborative research in this field. (국민대는 2018년 GE Aerospace와 무인기 시스템 관련 연구 협력 업무협약을 체결한 이후 긴밀한 협력 관계를 이어오고 있다. 특히 2021년부터 2024년까지 양자 보안 통합 항공전자 슈트 개발 과제를 수행하며 관련 분야의 공동 연구 기반을 축적해 왔다.)

Head Sohn Jin-sik stated, "The areas of unmanned system avionics, autonomous navigation, and MUM-T MOSA are core domains for the future defense aviation industry," adding, "I anticipate that the research capabilities accumulated by Kookmin Research Institute, the Defense Unmanned R&D Center, the Department of Electronic Engineering, and the Graduate School of Automotive Mobility will take a significant leap forward through this seminar, and that it will serve as a starting point for cooperation where industry, academia, and research institutes jointly design the future." (손진식 단장은 “무인 시스템의 항공전자와 자율주행, 유·무인 복합시스템 MOSA 분야는 미래 국방항공산업의 핵심 영역”이라며 “국민연구원, 국방무인R&D센터, 전자공학부, 자동차모빌리티대학원 등이 축적해 온 연구 역량이 이번 세미나를 통해 한 단계 더 도약하고, 산·학·연이 함께 미래를 설계하는 협력의 출발점이 되길 기대한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies' K-Beauty Division Visits 64th JUNO Hair Show for Global Beauty Field Experience (사이버한국외국어대학교 K뷰티학부, 64회 준오헤어쇼 견학…글로벌 뷰티 현장 체험)
item.description:
Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies (President Moon Hwi-chang) announced that its K-Beauty Division visited the "64th JUNO Hair Show" held at the aT Center in Yangjae-dong, Seoul, on Tuesday, April 21. (사이버한국외국어대학교(총장 문휘창) K뷰티학부는 지난 4월 21일(화) 서울 양재동 aT센터에서 열린 ‘제64회 준오헤어쇼(64th JUNO Hair Show)’를 견학했다고 밝혔다.)

This visit to the JUNO Hair Show was arranged at the invitation of JUNO Hair, which has maintained a close cooperative relationship with the K-Beauty Division since its inception. Held twice a year, the JUNO Hair Show has established itself as the official debut stage for emerging designers presenting hair trends each season. Approximately 5,000 attendees, including designers and staff from JUNO Hair as well as global beauty industry professionals, gathered for the event. There, 145 junior stylists from the 64th class of JUNO Academy, who completed about 30 months of training and promotion courses, showcased a variety of looks encompassing cutting, coloring, perming, and styling under four concepts: "Dreamer Mode," "Steel Eye Bloom," "Escape: Hair Odyssey," and "Hip Pop." <<> Current students and alumni of Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies' K-Beauty Division who participated in the visit shared positive feedback, saying, "It was beneficial to see trendy hairstyling up close and take notes," and "It was an opportunity to directly observe styling under various themes, enhancing the sense and practical skills needed in the field." <<> Professor Choi Seo-yeon, head of the K-Beauty Division at Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies, who led the visit to the JUNO Hair Show, stated, "I am very pleased to have watched the hair show together with JUNO Hair, which has an educational partnership with our university," adding, "Seeing the bold colors and structural cuts on stage, I believe the students experienced trends beyond the textbook." She further remarked, "I expect that the stage performances of junior designers who trained for 30 months in particular will serve as great inspiration for our students to gauge the standards and passion of the practical field." <<> Meanwhile, the K-Beauty Division at Cyber Hankuk University of Foreign Studies is a department dedicated to nurturing global total beauty experts aligned with the trends of the K-Culture era. It provides solid theoretical education to strengthen practical beauty skills, along with a systematic practice process that prepares students to compete in national and international beauty competitions. Since its first year, the division has achieved tangible educational outcomes, including winning a Ministerial Award at prestigious domestic beauty skills contests such as the Korea CIDESCO Beauty Therapy Online Competition. <<> Additionally, it has signed business agreements, educational partnerships, and industry commissioned training contracts with leading K-beauty companies and organizations, including JUNO Hair, the Korea Cosmetics Association, and the Korea Skin Care Association Central. item.title: Chung-Ang University School of Economics Hosts Special Lecture by World-Renowned Scholar Professor Ha-Joon Chang (중앙대 경제학부, ‘세계적 석학’ 장하준 교수 초청 특별강연 개최)
item.description:
The School of Economics at Chung-Ang University (President Park Se-hyun) will host a special lecture featuring world-renowned economist Professor Ha-Joon Chang of the University of London on Thursday, the 30th, at 4:30 PM in room 505 of building 310 at the Seoul campus. (중앙대학교(총장 박세현) 경제학부가 오는 30일(목) 오후 4시 30분, 서울캠퍼스 310관 505호에서 세계적인 경제학자 장하준 런던대 교수를 초청해 특별강연을 개최한다.)

This lecture, part of the School of Economics seminar series, is an open event that is expected to provide a valuable opportunity for university members and anyone interested in economics to directly engage with the insights of a globally esteemed scholar. (이번 강연은 경제학부 세미나 시리즈의 일환으로 마련된 공개 강연으로, 학내 구성원은 물론 경제학에 관심 있는 이들이 세계적 석학의 식견을 직접 접할 수 있는 소중한 기회가 될 전망이다.)

Professor Ha-Joon Chang, the speaker, is an authority in the fields of political economy and development economics. He has garnered attention from academia and the public worldwide through his sharp analyses of economic development and industrial policy. Notably, he has established a unique research domain through numerous best-selling works, including "Kicking Away the Ladder" and "Bad Samaritans." (강연자로 나서는 장하준 교수는 정치경제학 및 개발경제학 분야의 권위자로, 경제 발전과 산 업정책에 관한 날카로운 분석을 통해 전 세계 학계와 대중의 주목을 받아왔다. 특히 『사다리 걷어차기(Kicking Away the Ladder)』, 『나쁜 사마리아인들(Bad Samaritans)』 등 다수의 베 스트셀러 저술을 통해 독보적인 연구 영역을 구축하고 있다.)

The lecture will be held under the theme "Global Geopolitical Changes and the New World Economic Order." It will delve deeply into the implications of the emerging economic order amid rapidly changing international circumstances, such as the recent restructuring of global supply chains, intensifying economic competition between nations, and the spread of protectionism. (이날 강연은 ‘세계 지정학적 변화와 새로운 세계 경제질서’를 주제로 진행된다. 최근 글로벌 공급망 재편, 국가 간 경제 경쟁 심화, 보호무역주의 확산 등 급변하는 국제 정세 속에서 새 롭게 형성되는 경제질서의 함의를 심도 있게 다룰 예정이다.)

A representative from the School of Economics expressed anticipation, stating, "At a time of growing geopolitical uncertainty worldwide, Professor Ha-Joon Chang’s lecture will greatly help our students gain insight into and broaden their understanding of the structural changes in the global economy." (경제학부 관계자는 “전 세계적으로 지정학적 불확실성이 커지는 시기에 장하준 교수님의 강연 은 우리 학생들이 세계 경제의 구조적 변화를 통찰하고 이해를 넓히는 데 큰 도움이 될 것”이 라며 기대감을 전했다.)

item.title: Growth rate recovers on semiconductor boom but… high oil price burden emerges, consumer sentiment plunges as warning signs flash (반도체 활황에 성장률 회복했지만…고유가 물가 부담 가시화, 소비심리 급랭 경고음)
item.description:
As the US-Israel and Iran war enters its third month as of the 28th, the South Korean economy appears to be shrugging off the war's adverse effects, with growth rates and stock prices recovering to pre-war levels thanks to a semiconductor boom. However, the burden of high oil prices on prices is gradually becoming apparent, and consumer sentiment is rapidly cooling, raising serious warning signs about a slowdown in the real economy. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁이 28일로 세 달째에 접어드는 가운데, 한국 경제는 반도체 활황으로 성장률이나 주가가 전쟁 이전 수준을 회복하면서 전쟁 악재를 털어내는 듯한 모습을 보인다. 그러나 고유가로 인한 물가 부담이 점차 가시화되고, 소비심리가 급랭하고 있어 실물경기 둔화에 대한 본격적인 경고음이 나온다.)

The first-quarter growth rate (preliminary estimate) announced on the 23rd was 1.7%, recording a 'surprise growth' nearly double the Bank of Korea's forecast (0.9%). Although factors that could slow growth, such as supply chain disruptions due to the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, are expected to be fully reflected from the second quarter onward, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) also maintained its forecast for South Korea's growth rate at 1.9% this month, observing solid growth driven by semiconductors despite high oil price pressures. (지난 23일 발표된 1분기 성장률(속보치)은 1.7%로 한국은행 전망치(0.9%)를 두배 가까이 웃도는 ‘깜짝 성장’을 기록했다. 호르무즈해협 봉쇄에 따른 공급망 교란 등 성장률 둔화 요인은 2분기부터 본격 반영될 예정이지만, 이달 국제통화기금(IMF) 역시 올해 한국 성장률 전망치를 1.9%로 유지하면서 고유가 압력에도 ‘반도체발’ 견조한 성장을 관측했다.)

The financial market, which fully absorbed the shock of crude oil supply shortages from the Middle East, is also gradually moving past the war woes. This is because, amid a stalemate in ceasefire negotiations, the market has become desensitized to war news, recently triggering a full-fledged 'earnings rally' for semiconductor companies. On the 27th, the KOSPI broke through 6,600 for the first time in history, with the proportion of Samsung Electronics (including preferred shares) and SK hynix in the total market capitalization of the securities market reaching 43.6%, the highest level in a year. This means that nearly half of the market's weight is concentrated in just two stocks. While the KOSPI's total market capitalization has expanded 2.6 times over the past year, the rise excluding major semiconductor stocks was only 1.9 times. (중동산 원유 수급난의 충격을 고스란히 흡수했던 금융시장도 전쟁 악재에서 점차 벗어나는 모습이다. 종전 협상이 교착 상태를 보이는 가운데 시장이 전쟁 소식에 무뎌지면서, 최근 들어 반도체 기업 ‘실적 랠리’가 본격화하는 양상이기 때문이다. 27일 코스피는 사상 처음 6600을 돌파했는데, 유가증권시장 시가총액 가운데 삼성전자(우선주 포함)와 에스케이(SK)하이닉스의 비율이 43.6%를 차지하며 최근 1년 새 가장 높은 수치를 기록했다. 시장의 절반 가까운 무게가 단 두 종목에 실려 있다는 뜻이다. 코스피 시가총액은 지난 1년간 2.6배로 확대됐는데, 반도체 대형주를 제외한 코스피 상승은 1.9배에 그쳤다.)

Although expectations for economic growth driven by semiconductors and financial market optimism are increasing, the burden of prices, which can directly impact the real economy, is becoming more evident. The producer price index for March rose 1.6% from the previous month, marking the highest level in 3 years and 11 months since April 2022 (1.6%), right after the outbreak of the Russia-Ukraine war. This was driven by sharp increases in petroleum products like naphtha (68.0%) and diesel (20.8%). These are expected to affect industrial product prices and gradually be reflected in consumer prices. A government official stated, "Despite the maximum oil price system, the consumer price inflation rate for April is expected to be in the mid-to-late 2% range, and in May, it could exceed 3%." (반도체가 견인하는 경제성장과 금융시장의 기대감이 커지고 있지만, 실물경기에 즉각적인 영향을 줄 수 있는 물가 부담은 점점 가시화되는 상황이다. 3월 생산자물가지수는 전월보다 1.6% 상승하면서 러시아-우크라이나 전쟁 발발 직후인 2022년 4월(1.6%) 이후 3년11개월 만에 최고치를 기록했다. 석유제품인 나프타(68.0%), 경유(20.8%) 등이 크게 치솟으면서다. 이는 공산품 가격에도 영향을 줘 소비자물가에 점차 반영될 전망이다. 정부 관계자는 “석유 최고가격제에도 4월 소비자물가 상승률은 2% 중후반대를 예상하고, 5월엔 3%가 넘을 수도 있다”고 말했다.)

Consumer sentiment, which had been on a recovery trend since the second half of last year, is also freezing. The Consumer Sentiment Index announced by the Bank of Korea on the 23rd stood at 99.2, down 7.8 points from the previous month, falling for the second consecutive month. A reading above 100 indicates optimism compared to the long-term average, while below 100 indicates pessimism. It recorded the largest drop since December 2024 (-12.7), when the December 3rd insurrection occurred, shifting back to 'pessimistic' relative to the long-term average. (지난해 하반기 이후 회복세에 놓였던 소비심리도 얼어붙고 있다. 지난 23일 한국은행이 발표한 소비자심리지수는 99.2로 전월 대비 7.8 하락하며 두달 연속 내렸다. 기준값 100 이상이면 장기평균보다 낙관적, 100보다 작을 땐 비관적이라는 뜻이다. 12·3 내란이 있던 2024년 12월(-12.7) 이후 최대 폭으로 하락하면서 장기평균 대비 ‘비관적’으로 돌아섰다.)

March card approval amounts, a real-time indicator of consumption, continued to rise, increasing by 8.4%, but card approvals at discount stores, which mainly include food consumption, decreased by 32.5%. Ha Geon-hyung, a researcher at Shinhan Investment & Securities, said, "While the effects of the second-quarter supplementary budget are anticipated, price shocks from rising energy prices are mixed in, so consumption growth is expected to slow down as we move into the second half of the year." The government, while expecting effects from the high oil price damage subsidies that began payment on the 27th, plans to announce additional measures soon to prevent the decline in consumer sentiment from leading to a contraction in domestic demand. (소비 속보 지표인 3월 카드 승인액은 8.4% 늘어나는 등 증가세를 이어가고 있으나, 먹거리 소비 등이 주로 포함된 할인점 카드 승인액은 32.5% 감소했다. 하건형 신한투자증권 연구원은 “2분기 추가경정예산 효과 반영이 기대되지만, 에너지 가격 상승에 따른 물가 충격이 혼재돼 있어 하반기로 갈수록 소비 성장세는 둔화될 것으로 예상한다”고 했다. 정부는 27일 지급을 시작한 고유가 피해 지원금 등의 효과를 기대하는 한편, 소비심리 하락이 내수 위축으로 이어지지 않도록 조만간 추가 대책도 발표할 예정이다.)

However, some suggest that the price burden and consumer sentiment decline may not directly translate into actual consumption contraction. Lee Seung-hoon, a researcher at Meritz Securities, raised his private consumption forecast for this year from 1.8% to 1.9% after the first-quarter GDP announcement, saying, "There are simultaneous factors: side effects (consumption constraints) from rising oil prices, the supplementary budget, and favorable stock market conditions." The point is that the 'wealth effect,' where the rise in stock prices due to the KOSPI boom leads to consumption, should also be considered. (다만 일각에선 물가 부담과 소비심리 하락이 실제 소비 위축으로 직결되지 않을 수 있다는 의견도 나온다. 이승훈 메리츠증권 연구원은 1분기 지디피 발표 이후 올해 민간소비 전망을 1.8%에서 1.9%로 되레 높이면서 “유가 상승으로 인한 부작용(소비 제약 요인)과 추가경정예산, 증시 호조 요인이 동시에 있는 상황”이라고 말했다. 코스피 활황에 따른 주가 상승이 소비를 이끄는 ‘자산 효과’(wealth effect)도 함께 봐야 한다는 취지다.)

item.title: 31.9 Trillion Won in Mid-Interest Loans to Be Supplied… Interest Rates Lowered by Up to 5.2 Percentage Points (중금리대출 31.9조원 공급…금리 최대 5.2%포인트 낮춘다)
item.description:
The government will supply 31.9 trillion won in mid-interest loans for mid-credit borrowers this year. The interest rate on the policy product 'Sa-it-dol Loan' will be lowered by up to 5.2 percentage points, and a new product exclusively for individual business owners will also be introduced. (정부가 올해 중신용자용 중금리 대출을 31조9천억원 규모로 공급한다. 정책 상품인 ‘사잇돌대출’ 금리는 최대 5.2%포인트 낮추고, 개인사업자 전용 상품도 새로 도입하기로 했다.)

The Financial Services Commission announced a plan to boost mid-interest loans on the 27th. Mid-interest loans are products primarily used by mid-credit borrowers, who find it difficult to use banks, from secondary financial institutions. While interest rate fluctuations based on credit ratings are natural, a 'interest rate cliff' where rates spike sharply between high-credit and mid-credit borrowers has been pointed out as a problem. As of August last year, interest rates for high-credit borrowers were around 4.9–5.0%, while those for mid-credit borrowers rapidly rose to 5.4–10.7%. This creates a structure where borrowers pushed out of bank loans due to lower credit ratings immediately face high interest rates. (금융위원회는 27일 이런 내용의 중금리 대출 활성화 방안을 발표했다. 중금리 대출은 은행 이용이 어려운 중신용자가 주로 제2금융권에서 이용하는 상품이다. 신용등급에 따른 이자율 변동은 자연스러운 일이지만, 고신용자와 중신용자 사이에 금리 수준이 급격히 뛰는 ‘금리 단층’이 문제로 지적된다. 지난해 8월 기준 고신용자 금리는 4.9~5.0% 수준인 반면, 중신용자는 5.4∼10.7%로 빠르게 상승한다. 신용등급 저하로 은행권 대출에서 밀려나면 곧바로 고금리에 직면하는 구조다.)

To address this issue, the Financial Services Commission first decided to restructure Sa-it-dol Loans, focusing on mid-credit borrowers and lowering interest rates. Sa-it-dol Loans are credit loan products created by the government and the banking sector, supplied through guarantees from the Seoul Guarantee Insurance Company. (이런 문제를 해결하기 위해 먼저 금융위는 사잇돌대출을 중신용자 중심으로 개편해 금리를 낮추기로 했다. 사잇돌대출은 정부와 은행권이 만든 신용 대출 상품으로, 서울보증보험의 보증을 통해 공급하는 정책 대출이다.)

Previously, Sa-it-dol Loans were required to supply over 70% to borrowers in the lower 50% credit bracket. In the future, this will change to require over 70% supply to the 20-50% lower bracket. Low-credit borrowers in the lower 20% bracket will be directed to policy-based microfinance programs funded by the government, effectively separating them. This is because reducing the proportion of low-credit borrowers with high default and delinquency risks allows for further interest rate cuts. Consequently, the Financial Services Commission estimates that the interest rate for commercial banks' 'Sa-it-dol 1' will drop from 7.3–14.5% to 7.1–9.3%, and for secondary financial institutions like savings banks' 'Sa-it-dol 2,' from 11.1–17.2% to 11.2–14.6%. (기존 사잇돌대출은 신용 하위 50% 차주에 70% 이상 공급하도록 했는데, 앞으로는 하위 20~50% 구간에 70% 이상을 공급하도록 바꾼다. 하위 20% 저신용자는 재정이 투입되는 정책서민금융으로 유도해 분리하기로 했다. 연체·부도 가능성이 큰 저신용자 차주의 비중이 줄어들면 추가적인 금리 인하가 가능하기 때문이다. 이에 따라 시중은행 ‘사잇돌1’ 금리는 7.3~14.5%에서 7.1~9.3%로, 저축은행 등 제2금융권 ‘사잇돌2’ 금리는 11.1~17.2%에서 11.2~14.6%로 낮아질 것으로 금융위는 추산했다.)

A new Sa-it-dol Loan exclusively for individual business owners will also be introduced. The loan limit will expand from the current 20 million won to 30 million won, reflecting business information such as sales and business history. (개인사업자 전용 사잇돌대출도 신설된다. 매출, 업력 등 사업자 정보를 반영해 대출한도를 기존 2천만원에서 3천만원으로 확대한다.)

Incentives for private mid-interest loans will also be strengthened. Changes in loan costs will be reflected in interest rate requirements so that cost reductions lead to lower rates. Additionally, up to 80% of private mid-interest loans will be exempted from financial institutions' total household loan regulations. As a result, the total supply of mid-interest loans this year is expected to reach 31.9 trillion won, an increase of 1.1 trillion won from the previous year. (민간 중금리 대출 유인도 강화한다. 대출원가 변동분을 금리 요건에 반영해 원가 절감이 금리 인하로 이어지도록 하고, 금융사의 가계대출 총량 규제에서도 민간 중금리 대출은 최대 80%까지 제외하기로 했다. 이에 따라 올해 중금리 대출 총 공급 규모는 전년보다 1조1천억원 늘어난 31조9천억원 수준이 될 전망이다.)

item.title: Three Days Before Homeplus Rehabilitation Extension Decision… Task of Resolving 200 Billion Won Funding Gap (홈플러스 회생 연장 결정 사흘 앞…2천억 자금 공백 해소 과제)
item.description:
With Harim Group's push to acquire Homeplus Express, expectations are growing in some quarters that Homeplus has passed a critical hurdle for its rehabilitation. However, aside from the sale of Express, there are also considerable concerns that without the willingness of the largest creditor, Meritz Financial Group, to provide financial support, the worst-case scenario of Homeplus's bankruptcy could become a reality. (하림그룹의 홈플러스익스프레스 인수 추진으로 한편에서는 홈플러스가 회생을 위한 하나의 고비를 넘겼다는 기대감이 커지고 있다. 하지만 익스프레스 매각과 별개로 최대 채권자인 메리츠금융그룹의 금융지원 의지 없이는 홈플러스 파산이라는 최악의 시나리오가 현실화할 수 있다는 우려도 만만찮다.)

The deadline set by the Seoul Bankruptcy Court for deciding whether to extend the rehabilitation plan is May 4th. Considering holidays such as Labor Day and the weekend, a practical decision is expected to be made as early as the 30th. The funds needed to normalize Homeplus are estimated at around 600 billion won. This is the minimum amount required to withstand annual operating losses of 400 billion won, complete the restructuring of about 40 stores, and achieve a turnaround to profitability. Even combining the 100 billion won in emergency operating funds (Debtor-in-Possession, DIP) injected by majority shareholder MBK Partners and the estimated acquisition price for Express by Harim (under 300 billion won), there is still a shortfall of over 200 billion won. (서울회생법원이 지정한 회생계획안 연장 여부 결정 기한은 오는 5월4일이다. 노동절과 주말 등 연휴를 고려하면 실질적 결정은 이르면 오는 30일께 날 것으로 보인다. 홈플러스 정상화에 필요한 자금은 약 6천억원으로 추산된다. 연간 4천억원에 이르는 영업적자를 버티며 40여개 점포 구조조정을 마치고 흑자 전환을 이루기 위한 최소 금액이다. 대주주 엠비케이(MBK)파트너스가 투입한 긴급운영자금(DIP) 1천억원과 하림의 익스프레스 인수 추정가(3천억원 미만)를 합해도 2천억원 이상 부족한 상황이다.)

The market points to Meritz Financial as the realistic entity to fill this gap. Meritz (securities, fire & marine insurance, and capital) is the largest creditor, holding about 1.2 trillion won of Homeplus's total debt of approximately 2.6 trillion won—nearly half. They hold collateral on about 60 Homeplus stores, giving them priority to recover collateral assets before other creditors if Homeplus defaults on its debts. However, Meritz has stated that it has "not reviewed" injecting new funds, citing concerns about shareholder value erosion and the need for the majority shareholder (MBK) to take responsibility first. From Meritz's perspective, it may be more advantageous to choose liquidation and recover funds rather than extend the rehabilitation process and face ongoing uncertainty. Meritz is known to have recovered approximately 250 billion won so far. (시장에서는 이 공백을 메울 현실적 주체로 메리츠금융을 지목한다. 메리츠(증권·화재·캐피탈)는 홈플러스 전체 채권(약 2조6천억원)의 절반에 가까운 약 1조2천억원을 보유한 최대 채권자다. 이들은 홈플러스 점포 60여곳을 담보로 잡고 있어 홈플러스가 빚을 못 갚을 경우 다른 채권자들보다 먼저 담보 자산을 회수할 수 있는 우선권을 가진다. 다만, 메리츠 쪽은 신규 자금 투입에 대해 “검토한 바 없다”는 입장이다. 주주 가치 훼손 우려와 대주주(엠비케이)의 책임 경영이 우선이라는 이유에서다. 메리츠 입장에서는 회생 절차를 연장해 불확실성을 안고 가기보다 청산을 선택해 자금을 회수하는 편이 유리하다. 메리츠는 현재까지 2500억원 가량을 회수한 것으로 알려졌다.)

If Meritz does not agree to extend the rehabilitation, the court may choose to "sell Express and then proceed with the bankruptcy of the Homeplus parent company." This is why the labor union and political circles are urging Meritz, as the primary creditor, to take responsibility. An Soo-yong, head of the Homeplus labor union branch, stated, "This is a company involving the lives of hundreds of thousands of people, so a responsible creditor should actively step up to stabilize its finances." When Homeplus submitted its rehabilitation plan to the court last December, it requested 100 billion won in emergency operating funds each from MBK, Meritz, and the Korea Development Bank (KDB), but Meritz and KDB did not respond. MBK, which has currently provided 200 billion won in cash support, has indicated it would provide an additional 100 billion won after a new administrator is appointed and a new rehabilitation plan is submitted. (메리츠가 회생 연장에 동의하지 않을 경우 법원이 ‘익스프레스 매각 후 홈플러스 본체 파산’을 선택할 가능성이 있다. 노조와 정치권이 메리츠를 향해 제1채권자로서 책임을 촉구하는 이유다. 안수용 홈플러스 노조 지부장은 “수십만의 삶이 걸린 기업인 만큼 책임 있는 채권자라면 자금 안정화에 적극적으로 나서야 한다”고 말했다. 홈플러스는 지난해 12월 법원에 회생계획안을 제출하면서 엠비케이·메어렵사리츠·한국산업은행에 각각 1천억원의 긴급운영자금을 요청했지만, 메리츠와 산은은 응하지 않았다. 현재 2천억원의 현금성 지원을 한 엠비케이는 향후 새로운 관리인으로 교체 후 새 회생계획 제출시 1천억원을 추가 지원하겠다고 밝힌 바 있다.)

Even if Meritz's agreement is painstakingly secured, challenges remain. Homeplus currently has unpaid goods payments amounting to approximately 200 billion won. Suppliers, worried about the possibility of bankruptcy, are reluctant to supply goods, leading to a vicious cycle of empty shelves, declining sales, and inability to pay debts. This is why restoring trust is as urgent as securing funds. (어렵사리 메리츠의 동의가 이뤄진다 해도 과제는 남는다. 현재 홈플러스의 미납 물품 대금은 약 2천억원에 이른다. 납품업체들이 파산 가능성을 우려해 공급을 꺼리면서 진열대가 비고 매출이 줄고 대금을 못 갚는 악순환이 이어지고 있다. 돈만큼이나 ‘신뢰 회복’이 시급한 이유다.)

To overcome this, the labor union and political circles have proposed a third-party management system involving UAMCO (United Asset Management Company). UAMCO is a corporate restructuring specialist company jointly funded by state-run banks such as the Korea Development Bank and the Export-Import Bank of Korea, as well as commercial banks. The union and political circles envision that if UAMCO joins as an administrator, it would signal to the market that a public institution is involved, potentially prompting suppliers to resume supply. However, UAMCO is reportedly reluctant to intervene due to the complex issues entangled in the Homeplus situation—such as wage arrears and restructuring—and the fact that it is not a national core industry. (이를 극복하기 위해 노조와 정치권이 꺼내 든 카드가 유암코(연합자산관리)가 참여하는 제3자 관리체제다. 유암코는 한국산업은행·한국수출입은행 등 국책은행과 시중은행이 공동 출자한 기업구조조정 전문 회사다. 유암코가 관리인으로 합류하면 사실상 공적 기관이 개입했다는 신호가 시장에 전달돼, 납품업체들이 공급을 재개하는 계기가 될 수 있다는 것이 노조와 정치권의 구상이다. 다만 유암코 쪽은 홈플러스 사태에 임금 체불·구조조정 등 복잡한 문제가 얽혀있고 국가기간산업도 아니라는 점에서 개입에 부담을 느끼는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Ultimately, workers and civic groups argue that Homeplus's rehabilitation is possible only through a "two-track" approach: the largest creditor Meritz must provide liquidity to allow the extension of the deadline for approving the rehabilitation plan instead of bankruptcy, and UAMCO must restore supply chain trust by normalizing goods payment. The Homeplus Crisis Resolution Joint Countermeasure Committee held a press conference at the National Assembly on the 27th, urging "UAMCO's decision and active mediation by the government and the court," stating that "the Homeplus crisis is a social crisis linked to 100,000 workers, over 3,000 partner companies, and thousands of tenant merchants." (결국 홈플러스의 회생은 최대 채권자인 메리츠가 유동성을 공급해 파산 대신 회생 계획안 가결 기한을 연장할 수 있도록 하고, 유암코는 납품대금 지급 정상화 등으로 공급망 신뢰를 복원하는 ‘투트랙’이 맞물려야 가능하다는 것이 노동자와 시민단체의 주장이다. 홈플러스사태해결공동대책위원회는 27일 국회에서 기자회견을 열어 “홈플러스 사태는 10만 명의 노동자와 3천여개 협력업체, 수천 명의 입점업주가 연결된 사회적 위기”라며 유암코의 결단과 정부·법원의 적극적인 조정을 촉구했다.)

Reporter Lee Ju-bin yes@hani.co.kr (이주빈 기자 yes@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [News AS] HWP shaken by open source and AI expansion?… Hancom, reasons for being relaxed? ([뉴스AS] 오픈소스·AI 확산에 흔들리는 HWP?…한컴, 느긋한 이유는?)
item.description:
First released in 1989, "Hancom Office Hangul" (Hangul), a symbol of homegrown office software for 37 years, has reached a new turning point in the age of AI. This is because free tools that can open and edit documents in HWP (HWP·HWPX) format through a web browser without installing software have emerged, and recently, the government announced a policy to restrict the attachment of HWP files due to low AI recognition rates. While some raise crisis theories about the developer, Hancom Inc., the company itself appears to be anticipating an expansion of its user ecosystem. <<> In mid-February, the open-source application 'rhwp - HWP Document Viewer & Editor' was released on the Chrome Web Store, allowing users to view and edit Hangul documents in Chrome without installing software on their PC. Created by a domestic developer, this app gained traction through word-of-mouth and secured around 60,000 users as of the 27th. Reactions among netizens included comments like, "Now we don't have to buy expensive Hancom programs." <<> Hancom views the emergence of the open-source Hangul app not as a threat but as a sign of change. The company states that since 2010, it has been disclosing the internal structure of the HWP format and has provided HWPX, an open format that allows AI and others to easily read and utilize documents. Accordingly, they maintain that there is no issue with concerns raised by some about intellectual property (IP) infringement by the open-source app. A Hancom official explained, "Even before the advent of generative AI, we have consistently disclosed technologies related to document tools," adding, "The rhwp app is also a natural flow within the open technology ecosystem." <<> The company is instead focusing on the potential for the Hangul document usage ecosystem to expand. This is because, while MS Word still holds an overwhelmingly high market share in private enterprises, accessibility for individual users could significantly improve. The availability of web-based tools for handling Hangul documents without installed software means the user base could broaden. <<> Recent policies from the government and big tech also seem far from phasing out Hangul documents. On the 24th, the National AI Strategy Committee decided to restrict the attachment of HWP files, which have low AI recognition rates, in systems like the 'Onnara System,' the government's document drafting and distribution channel. However, they decided to encourage the use of HWPX format documents, which machines can more easily analyze and learn from. OpenAI also began supporting domestic users in uploading Hangul documents to ChatGPT this month without file conversion. <<> Hancom is also seeking to change its business direction. Based on cash secured from its existing installed office software business, it is pursuing expansion into AI-based products, subscription services, and overseas markets like Japan. Hancom is participating in the LG AI Research Institute consortium, a specialized team for the 'Proprietary AI Foundation Model' project, while also expanding its AI-related business areas, such as building an intelligent work management system for the Ministry of the Interior and Safety. <<> Reporter Seon Dam sun@hani.co.kr (1989년 첫 출시 이후 37년간 토종 오피스 소프트웨어의 상징으로 자리 잡은 ‘한컴오피스 한글’(한글)이 인공지능 시대를 맞아 새로운 전환점에 섰다. 프로그램 설치 없이 웹 브라우저에서 한글 형식(HWP·HWPX) 문서를 열고 편집할 수 있는 무료 도구가 등장한 데 이어, 최근 정부가 인공지능 인식률이 낮은 HWP 파일 첨부를 제한하는 방침을 발표했기 때문이다. 일각에선 개발사인 한글과컴퓨터(한컴)의 위기론을 제기하고 있지만, 회사는 이용자 생태계 확장을 기대하는 모습이다.)

item.title: ‘Annual returns of 13%’… How about designing your retirement with a life cycle-tailored TDF? (‘수익률 연 13%’…생애주기 맞춤 TDF로 노후 설계 해볼까?)
item.description:
The classic rule of investing is to take risks and pursue returns when you are young, then shift assets to safer options as retirement approaches. However, it is not easy to adjust your investment portfolio in a timely manner while working, raising a family, and going about daily life. Using wealth management services is also burdensome unless you are a high-net-worth individual. To address these limitations, attention is turning to ‘target-date funds’ (TDFs), which automatically adjust the balance between stocks and bonds according to life stages such as retirement timing. These funds are rapidly growing in size, particularly centered on retirement pension funds. (젊을 때는 위험을 감수하고 수익을 노리다가, 은퇴가 가까워질수록 자산을 보다 안전하게 옮기는 것은 투자의 정석이다. 하지만 직장을 다니고 가족을 꾸리고 생활을 이어가며 적기에 직접 투자 포트폴리오를 조정하는 것은 쉬운 일이 아니다. 거액 자산가가 아닌 이상 자산관리 서비스를 이용하는 것도 부담스럽다. 이런 한계를 보완하기 위해 나온 ‘생애주기펀드’(TDF·티디에프)에 관심이 쏠린다. 은퇴 시점 등 생애주기에 맞춰 주식과 채권의 비중을 자동으로 조정해주는 펀드로, 최근 퇴직연금 자금을 중심으로 빠르게 규모가 커지고 있다.)

According to the Financial Supervisory Service (FSS) on the 26th, the net assets of TDFs stood at 256 trillion won as of the end of 2025. The market, which was around 14 trillion won in 2018, has grown more than 18-fold in eight years. Since their introduction in 2016, TDFs have grown rapidly. After surpassing 100 trillion won for the first time at the end of 2021, they increased to 165 trillion won by the end of 2024, with an additional 90 trillion won flowing in within just the past year. Currently, 199 products have been launched. <<> TDFs are funds that adjust asset allocation based on age and retirement timing. Early in the investment period, a high proportion of risk assets like stocks is maintained, and as retirement approaches, the share of safe assets such as bonds gradually increases. For this reason, product names include target years like 2025, 2030, 2035, etc., in five-year increments. For example, someone born in 1980 planning to retire at age 65 would enroll in a ’TDF2045’ product. <<> Asset management companies can autonomously determine the allocation between safe and risk assets. However, to encourage operation aligned with the system's purpose, the FSS grants ‘qualified TDF’ status to products that meet certain criteria. The conditions require maintaining a safe asset share of at least 20% before the target date and at least 60% after it. Currently, 98% (195 products) of launched TDFs meet this standard. Products recognized as qualified are exempt from the retirement pension risk asset investment limit (70%), allowing the entire accumulated amount to be invested in the TDF. The product name also includes the term ‘qualified.’ <<> <<> What about returns? Last year, the annual return of TDFs was 13.7%. This is about twice the overall retirement pension return (6.5%) and nearly four times the default option return (3.7%), which is mainly managed with principal-guaranteed products. This trend is confirmed by earlier returns as well. In 2024, the TDF return was 13.8%, significantly surpassing the overall retirement pension return (4.8%) and the default option return (4.1%). This indicates that the performance of TDF returns is not an exceptional result driven solely by last year's stock market boom. <<> Additionally, the further away the target date, the higher the returns. This is because products with more distant target dates have a higher proportion of risk assets like stocks. Last year, TDFs with a target date of 2030 recorded an annual return of 11.9%, while products for 2045, 2050, and 2055 achieved returns of 15.8%, 16.1%, and 15.3%, respectively. <<> Even with the same target date, returns can vary significantly depending on the management strategy. Last year, the return gap between products with the same target date ranged from at least 7.7 percentage points to up to 24.5 percentage points. In particular, for products targeting 2055, the maximum return was 31.6%, while the minimum return was only 7.1%. <<> This is why it is necessary to carefully examine the prospectus. Investors can check the management strategy in the ‘Investment Strategy, Risk Management, and Return Structure’ section of the product prospectus. From the 1st of this month, the FSS has amended relevant regulations to help investors understand management strategies more easily. It now requires the presentation of charts and graphs, and clear indication of the target proportion of risk and safe assets in five-year increments based on the target date. Additionally, qualification status must also be included. <<> Another area to explore is the country-specific investment allocation. This is because concentration of investments in a particular country can increase risks from market fluctuations. Currently, the country with the highest investment share is the United States. As of 2025, an average of 43% is invested in the U.S., and some TDFs have a U.S. investment share of up to 80%. In particular, a high foreign investment share can also expose investors to exchange rate risk. In contrast, the domestic investment share averages only 4.4%, and even the product with the highest share is relatively low at 35.4%. Individual investors should choose their country-specific investment allocation based on their investment preferences. <<> The fee level, where asset management companies deduct a portion of returns, should also be compared. Since these are long-term investment products, the impact on returns is not insignificant. <<> Specific product returns, asset compositions, and fees can be found on each financial company's website. Even the investment items can be examined in detail. <<> An FSS official said, “We plan to introduce a feature on the Integrated Pension Portal operated by the FSS that allows easy comparison of TDF products from different companies in one place,” and added, “We will improve the system, such as by finely adjusting the qualification criteria, to help TDFs become established as retirement investment products.” <<> Reporter Ahn Tae-ho eco@hani.co.kr ( 26일 금융감독원에 따르면, 2025년 말 기준 티디에프 순자산은 25조6천억원으로 집계됐다. 2018년 1조4천억원 수준이던 시장이 8년 만에 18배 넘게 커진 것이다. 티디에프는 2016년 처음 도입된 이후 빠르게 성장했다. 2021년 말 10조원을 처음 넘어선 데 이어, 2024년 말 16조5천억원으로 늘었고, 이후 1년 사이에만 9조원이 추가로 유입됐다. 현재 출시된 상품은 199개에 이른다.)

item.title: Domestic Companies' Anxiety Over Middle East Eases… Business Sentiment Slightly Rebounds (국내 기업 중동 불안감 누그러져…기업 체감경기 소폭 반등)
item.description:
Companies' anxiety over the US-Israel and Iran war situation has slightly eased. Business sentiment also rebounded modestly. (미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 사태를 바라보는 기업들의 불안감이 약간 누그러진 것으로 나타났다. 기업 체감 경기도 소폭 반등했다.)

According to the April Business Survey results released by the Bank of Korea on the 28th, the overall Corporate Sentiment Index (CBSI) for all industries inched up 0.8 points from the previous month to 94.9. The CBSI is a psychological indicator calculated based on business conditions and financial situations across five manufacturing and four non-manufacturing sectors. The average from January 2003 to December 2023 is set at 100, with a reading above this level indicating optimistic corporate sentiment. (28일 한국은행이 발표한 4월 기업경기 조사 결과를 보면, 이달 전체 산업 기업심리지수(CBSI)는 전달보다 0.8포인트 상승한 94.9로 나타났다. 기업심리지수는 제조업 5개와 비제조업 4개 부문에서 업황과 자금 사정 등을 바탕으로 산출한 기업의 심리 지표다. 과거(2003년 1월∼지난해 12월) 평균치를 100으로 두고, 이보다 높으면 기업 심리가 낙관적인 것으로 해석한다.)

By industry, the CBSI for manufacturing rose 2.0 points from the previous month to 99.1, while the index for non-manufacturing edged up 0.1 points to 92.1. In the manufacturing sector, product inventories and business conditions saw improvements, while in the non-manufacturing sector, sales contributed relatively significantly. (산업별로 보면 제조업 기업심리지수는 전달보다 2.0포인트 상승한 99.1을, 비제조업 지수는 0.1포인트 오른 92.1을 기록했다. 제조업은 제품재고, 업황 쪽에서 올랐고, 비제조업 분야에서는 매출의 기여도가 비교적 컸던 것으로 나타났다.)

The Bank of Korea attributed the slight rebound in business sentiment to "an increase in manufacturing sales and new orders, as well as a reduction in product inventories, despite rising raw material prices due to the Middle East conflict and production disruptions in some sectors." (한은은 기업 체감 경기 소폭 반등에 대해 “중동 전쟁으로 인한 원자재 가격 상승, 일부 업종의 생산 차질에도 불구하고 제조업 매출 및 신규 수주 증가, 제품 재고 축소 등의 영향”으로 풀이했다.)

For the outlook on the May CBSI, manufacturing rose 2.1 points from the previous month to 98.0, while non-manufacturing remained unchanged at 91.2. Overall, it increased 0.8 points from the previous month to 93.9. This figure had dropped 4.5 points to 93.1 last month, marking the largest decline since January last year, right after the December 3 insurrection. This is interpreted as reflecting a slight easing of companies' anxiety regarding the Middle East situation. (5월 기업심리지수 전망은 제조업이 전달보다 2.1포인트 오른 98.0이었고, 비제조업은 전달과 같은 91.2를 기록했다. 전체적으로는 전달보다 0.8포인트 오른 93.9를 기록했다. 이 수치가 지난달에는 93.1로 전달보다 4.5포인트 떨어져 12·3 내란 직후인 지난해 1월 이후 가장 큰 폭으로 떨어진 바 있다. 중동 사태를 바라보는 기업들의 불안감이 약간 낮아졌음을 반영한 것으로 풀이된다.)

'Rising raw material prices' were cited as the top business difficulty. In the manufacturing sector, challenges included 'rising raw material prices' at 34.2%, 'uncertain economic conditions' at 19.3%, and 'weak domestic demand' at 13.8%. For non-manufacturing, shares were 'rising raw material prices' at 19.4%, 'uncertain economic conditions' at 18.7%, and 'weak domestic demand' at 16.7%. Both manufacturing and non-manufacturing sectors reported a higher share of 'rising raw material prices' compared to the previous month (21.0% and 13.6%, respectively). (기업 경영애로 사항으로는 ‘원자재 가격 상승’이 가장 높게 꼽혔다. 제조업 부문은 ‘원자재 가격 상승’ 34.2%, ‘불확실한 경제 상황’ 19.3%, ‘내수부진’ 13.8%의 비중으로 거론했으며 비제조업 쪽은 ‘원자재 가격 상승’ 19.4%, ‘불확실산 경제 상황’ 18.7%, ‘내수 부진’ 16.7%로 꼽았다. 제조업, 비제조업 부문 모두 원자재 가격 상승을 전달(21.0%, 13.6%)보다 더 높은 비중으로 들었다.)

Kim Young-bae, Senior Reporter kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)

item.title: The Thrill of Abusing a 250 Million Won Defender… The Off-Road King ‘Octa Black’ [Test Drive] (2억5천 디펜더를 혹사하는 쾌감…오프로드 최강자 ‘옥타 블랙’ [시승기])
item.description:
As I selected Lynyrd Skynyrd’s ‘Free Bird’ through the 13.1-inch touchscreen, the legendary guitar solo began pounding through my entire body via the first-row ‘Body and Soul Seat,’ which converts sound into physical tactile sensations. Just as my heartbeat started to resonate, instructor Jeon Dae-eun signaled and floored the accelerator in an instant. The 2,665 kg heavy black body hesitated not a moment, bolting like a cannonball toward the unpaved road ahead. This behemoth, capable of a 0–100 km/h sprint in under 4 seconds—the strongest Defender ever, the Land Rover ‘Octa Black’—began tearing through the winding off-road terrain at tremendous speed. Bouncing rocks flew in like meteors, targeting the 5-meter-long body. A plume of dust trailed behind the Defender for dozens of meters like a comet’s tail. The thrill of mercilessly abusing a car worth nearly 250 million won washed over me. (13.1인치 터치스크린을 통해 미국 록 밴드 레너드 스키너드의 ‘프리 버드’를 선곡하자, 사운드를 물리적 촉각으로 전환시키는 1열의 ‘바디 앤 소울 시트’를 통해 전설적 기타 솔로가 온몸을 두드리기 시작했다. 심장박동이 공명하기 시작할 때쯤 전대은 인스트럭터가 신호를 주더니 엑셀러레이터를 단박에 끝까지 밟았다. 2665㎏짜리 육중한 검은 몸체는 주저하지 않고 전방의 비포장 도로를 향해 포탄처럼 튀어나갔다. 이 덩치에 제로백 4초를 끊는, 랜드로버의 디펜더 시리즈 최강자 ‘옥타(OCTA) 블랙’이 엄청난 속도로 구불구불한 오프로드를 휘젓기 시작했다. 튀어 오른 돌들이 5m짜리 차체를 표적 삼아 운석처럼 날아들었다. 디펜더를 따라 뿌연 흙먼지가 혜성 꼬리 모양으로 수십미터 이어졌다. 2억5천만원에 육박하는 차를 사정없이 혹사하는 쾌감이 밀려왔다.)

On the afternoon of the 16th, a media test drive event for the Octa Black, touted as the most powerful Defender in history, was held at the Bellfore Moto Arena circuit course in Jeungpyeong, North Chungcheong Province, and a nearby quarry converted into an off-road track. It was an event that compressed into about two hours a taste of the overwhelming performance that won the stock (production vehicle) category in its debut at this year’s Dakar Rally, the world’s toughest off-road race. (지난 16일 오후 충북 증평 벨포레 모토아레나 서킷 코스와 근처 채석장을 개조한 오프로드 코스에서 디펜더 역사상 가장 강력한 퍼포먼스를 자랑한다는 옥타 블랙 미디어 시승 행사가 열렸다. 올해 초 세계에서 가장 험난한 오프로드 레이스라는 다카르 랠리 데뷔전에서 스톡(양산차) 부문 우승을 차지한 압도적 퍼포먼스의 일부를 2시간여로 압축해 체험하는 자리였다.)

The model name Octa is said to be inspired by the octahedron structure of diamond, the hardest mineral on Earth. It’s a fitting name to convey its rugged yet attractive appearance and solid durability. It boasts a 4.4-liter twin-turbo mild hybrid V8 engine with a displacement of 4,395 cc, delivering a maximum output of 635 horsepower and peak torque of 76.5 kg·m (at 1,800–5,855 rpm). The 635 horsepower is comparable to that of the Porsche Cayenne Turbo GT (673 hp) and Lamborghini Urus (666 hp). (옥타라는 모델명은 지구상에서 가장 단단한 광물인 다이아몬드의 팔면체(octahedron) 구조에서 영감을 받았다고 한다. 강인하면서도 매력적인 외관과 견고한 내구성을 어필하는 데 적합한 명칭이다. 최고출력 635마력, 최대 토크 76.5㎏·m(rpm 1800∼5855)를 자랑하는, 배기량 4395cc의 4.4리터 트윈 터보 마일드 하이브리드 8기통 엔진을 탑재했다. 635마력은 포르쉐 카이엔 터보 GT(673마력), 람보르기니 우르스(666마력)와 비슷한 수준이다.)

The vehicle dimensions are: length 5,003 mm, width 2,064 mm, height 1,995 mm, and wheelbase 3,023 mm. To ensure supreme off-road performance, the ground clearance has been raised by 28 mm. Via the air suspension that adjusts the vehicle height, ground clearance can be increased up to 323 mm. This secures a maximum approach angle of 40.2 degrees, a departure angle of 42.8 degrees, and a ramp angle (the angle at which the vehicle’s underbody between the wheelbase avoids contact with the hilltop) of up to 29 degrees. (차체 크기는 전장(길이) 5003㎜, 전폭(너비) 2064㎜, 전고(높이) 1995㎜, 축거(휠베이스·앞뒤 바퀴 축간거리) 3023㎜다. 최강의 오프로드 성능을 보장하기 위해 지상고(노면과 차 바닥 사이 간격)는 28㎜ 올렸다. 차체 높낮이를 조절하는 에어 서스펜션을 통해 지상고를 323㎜까지 높일 수 있다. 이에 따라 경사로 접근 각도는 최대 40.2도, 이탈 각도는 42.8도, 램프 각도(휠베이스 사이 차량 바닥이 언덕 정상에 걸리지 않는 각도)는 29도까지 확보된다.)

I sat in the driver’s seat. Long-pressing the Octa logo button on the steering wheel switches the vehicle into ‘Octa Mode,’ optimizing all functions for off-road driving. I drove the Octa Black into the quarry-turned-off-road course. Even on slopes set at around 28–31 degrees, the car climbed steadily without issue. There was no sense that it lacked power to haul the heavy body. At the hilltop, as the car pointed skyward, a wave of anxiety hit me as forward visibility was lost. The ‘Clear Sight Ground View’ activated on the display, showing the view ahead as if looking through the hood. I could confidently press the accelerator and crest the hill. (직접 운전석에 앉았다. 운전석의 옥타 로고 모양 버튼을 길게 누르면 차량의 모든 기능을 오프로드 드라이빙으로 최적화시키는 ‘옥타 모드’로 전환된다. 채석장을 개조한 오프로드 코스로 옥타 블랙을 몰고 들어갔다. 등판각 28∼31도 정도로 설정된 오프로드 코스에서도 차는 무리 없이 안정적으로 올라갔다. 육중한 차체를 끌어올리는 데 힘이 달린다는 느낌은 전혀 없었다. 언덕 정상에서 차가 하늘을 향하자 전방 시야가 확보되지 않는 불안감이 밀려왔다. 디스플레이를 통해 보닛을 투과해서 전방을 보는 것 같은 ‘클리어 사이트 그라운드 뷰’가 작동했다. 안심하고 엑셀러레이터를 밟아 언덕을 넘을 수 있었다.)

Beyond one hill, another. A downhill slope appeared, as if the car might roll forward. Habitually, I nervously tapped and released the brake, but instructor Choi Jin-yeol in the passenger seat advised, “You don’t need to brake.” Even with my foot completely off the brake on a steep descent, the car automatically decelerated (down to a minimum of 3 km/h) according to the set speed, safely navigating the slope. (산 넘어 산. 앞으로 굴러떨어질 것 같은 내리막길이 나타났다. 습관처럼 브레이크를 신경질적으로 밟고 떼기를 반복하자, 조수석에 앉은 최진열 인스트럭터가 “브레이크를 밟지 않아도 된다”고 조언했다. 가파른 언덕길을 내려갈 때 브레이크에서 발을 확 떼어도 차는 설정 속도에 맞춰 알아서 감속(최저 3㎞까지 가능)해 안전하게 경사로를 내려갔다.)

I drove the car into a section littered with uneven rocks. One rear left wheel lifted into the air. The Octa Black passed through the rocky section as if nothing had happened. The Octa Black is designed to ford water up to 1 meter deep. As I submerged the car in a deep muddy water section, it reminded me of the ‘Xianzhe’ (a vehicle that made headlines in August 2022 by climbing onto a car hood during record downpours in the Seoul area). Muddy water surged as the heavy body pushed through, but the Octa Black completed the crossing effortlessly. A low, rumbling exhaust note and light vibrations shook off the moisture clinging to the car. (바위들이 울퉁불퉁 깔린 구간에 차를 올렸다. 왼쪽 뒷바퀴 하나가 허공에 떴다. 옥타 블랙은 무슨 일이 있었냐는 듯 암석 구간을 통과했다. 옥타 블랙은 최대 1m 수심의 물길을 건널 수 있도록 설계됐다. 흙탕물이 깊게 고인 구간에 차를 담그자, 2022년 8월 수도권에 기록적 폭우가 내렸을 때 차량 보닛 위에 올라가 화제가 됐던 ‘현자’가 떠올랐다. 육중한 차체에 밀린 흙탕물이 출렁였지만 옥타 블랙은 힘들이지 않고 도강을 마쳤다. ‘으르르르르르’, 중저음 배기음과 가벼운 진동이 차에 올라탄 물기를 털어냈다.)

Most city driving is on-road. I tested acceleration, braking, and cornering on the circuit course. I verified the 0–100 km/h sprint time of 4 seconds from a standstill. Slamming the accelerator relentlessly, the Octa Black lunged forward. The center of gravity shifted rearward, lifting the front end. It was over in an instant. As I passed the 100-meter marker, I stomped on the brake. The brake discs felt like they were gripping all four wheels firmly. Instructor Jeong Byeong-min in the passenger seat explained, “Large-diameter 400 mm front (365 mm rear) brake discs provide powerful and consistent braking performance.” (도시인의 운전은 대부분 온로드에서 이뤄진다. 서킷 코스에서 가속 성능과 브레이크, 코너링을 확인해 봤다. 정지 상태에서 시속 100㎞에 도달하는 제로백 4초를 실증해 봤다. 가차 없이 엑셀러레이터를 밟자 옥타 블랙이 전방 돌진을 시작했다. 무게 중심이 뒤로 쏠리며 차체 앞부분이 들렸다. 순식간이었다. 100m 지점을 표시한 구간을 지났을 때 브레이크를 힘껏 밟았다. 브레이크 디스크가 네 바퀴를 꽉 잡아준다는 느낌이 전해졌다. 조수석의 정병민 인스트럭터는 “400㎜(후면 365㎜) 대구경 사이즈가 적용되어 강력하고 균일한 제동 성능을 보여준다”고 설명했다.)

Speeding through the bumpy sections of the circuit, the undulations from the tires weren’t heavily transmitted. Even during aggressive cornering, the lateral rolling wasn’t severe. This is thanks to the Octa Black’s ‘6D Dynamic Air Suspension’ technology, they say. (서킷 코스의 요철 구간을 빠르게 통과하는데 타이어가 마주하는 굴곡감이 크게 전달되지 않았다. 과격한 코너링을 할 때도 좌우로 쏠리는 롤링이 심하지 않았다. 옥타 블랙이 자랑하는 ‘6D 다이내믹 에어 서스펜션’ 기술 덕분이라고 한다.)

All this performance comes at a cost, of course. The Octa Black’s fuel economy (km/l) is 6.3 km in the city and 8.1 km on the highway. The price is set at 245.47 million won. (이 모든 성능에는 당연히 비용이 따른다. 옥타 블랙 연비(㎞/ℓ)는 도심 6.3㎞, 고속도로 8.1㎞다. 가격은 2억4547만원으로 책정됐다.)

Kim Nam-il Reporter namfic@hani.co.kr (김남일 기자 namfic@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Drawing Pictures That Perfectly Fit My Heart [Dwireon Dwireon AI ⑥] (내 맘에 꼭 드는 그림 그리기 [두런두런 AI ⑥])
item.description:
Last spring, ChatGPT's Ghibli Studio style was a huge hit. As everyone jumped into playing with the Ghibli-style, over 700 million images were generated within a week of the service update. Sam Altman even said, "The GPUs are melting." (작년 봄, 챗지피티의 지브리 스튜디오 스타일이 엄청 유행했죠. 너도나도 지브리놀이에 뛰어들다보니 서비스 업데이트 이후 일주일 만에 7억장의 이미지가 생성됐어요. 샘 올트먼이 “지피유(GPU)가 녹아내리고 있다”고 말할 정도였죠.)

The lecture 'Gomtomi's AI Usage Guide,' held every Thursday evening at the Jjeom-o Bookstore in Paju Munbal-dong, is usually lively, but on the 23rd, when we learned how to create AI images, the bookstore heated up. Gommotomi, Lee Hae-beom—a software developer and video planner/producer—threw out a mountain of materials packed with information for various prompts, including camera lenses, angles, lighting, and styles. While thinking, 'Wow, doing all this might melt the earth,' the two agents of 'Sadi Lab,' Lee Joo-hyun and Han Gwi-young, couldn't stop their hands. <<> That day, Lee Hae-beom gave a lecture on image creation using Gemini. Gemini creates images using an engine called Nano Banana; the current Gemini 2 service from Google, Nano Banana 2, can be defined as "an image engine that translates the powerful reasoning capabilities of the Gemini 3 model into visual language." The characteristics of Nano Banana 2 are as follows. Lee Joo-hyun, a pure humanities major and reporter, is curious: 'I can understand "narrative context, real-time web search, and support for various languages," but what exactly is "multimodal input processing"?' I'll explain it again later. <<> To effectively utilize Nano Banana 2, the 'instruction' or prompt is crucial. Whether it's markdown, instructions, or skills, 'structuring' is important. The structure of an image prompt is equally important. Lee Hae-beom puts it this way: <<> "Instead of simply describing 'a beautiful landscape,' you need to instruct the scene's structural design." <<> The skeleton of this structural design is as follows: <<> SUBJECT-ACTION-LOCATION-COMPOSITION-STYLE <<> Let me give an example. <<> SUBJECT Minimalist ceramic coffee mug <<> ACTION Placed on a wooden table <<> LOCATION Sunlit neighborhood café <<> COMPOSITION Low-angle shot, f/1.8 shallow depth of field <<> STYLE Fujifilm look, warm-tone cinematic color grading, high-resolution texture. <<> Ah, indeed, you need to know something to give good instructions. <<> Even if you don't know it this professionally, it's better to instruct using concepts that are as specific and clear as possible. <<> Can't we just say, 'There's a minimalist ceramic coffee mug in a sunlit neighborhood café...'? <<> Naturally, this question arises. <<> It's not impossible, but... there is a difference. <<> In the first image, the mug is emphasized, whereas in the second image, the wooden table and the café's interior are captured. "This is because words positioned at the very front of the prompt are assigned higher weight during the model's association process," explains Lee Hae-beom. <<> Now, it's time to learn about multimodality. <<> Multimodality is the process of deriving a new image by fusing various types of input data—such as images, sketches, and textures—rather than relying solely on text prompts. <<> Lee Hae-beom gave the following two pictures and instructed: <<> "Use the figure placement and composition from the user-provided pencil sketch as the basic framework of the scene, and faithfully use the cool, predawn blue light source visible in the location photo. Combine these to draw a man's back view as he gazes down at the sea from a foggy cliff edge, as if resolved to do something, with the cinematic perspective of an anamorphic lens." <<> Here, "Use the user-provided... faithfully" explains the reference, and "Combine these to draw..." instructs the relationship. <<> Gemini used the two reference images to create the following new image: <<> Actually, the problem when creating images is a lack of precise understanding of composition, style, and the like. The more accurately you use directive terms like 'Make the camera a GoPro,' 'I prefer Leica,' or 'Give it a Fujifilm feel,' the higher the probability of creating the desired image. What can we do? We have no choice but to learn them one by one. T_T <<> Still, creating new images is truly fun. Let me introduce one style that drove Gomtomi's students wild. <<> Late on a Friday night, Gommotomi gave the students a gift-like prompt. (Used for chibi—cute, humorous scenes referring to kids in Japanese slang.) <<> 3D chibi-style miniature concept store of {Brand Name} <<> Reporter Lee Joo-hyun jumped right in. I tested it with a café on Malli-jae in front of the office. <<> "It's a café in front of the office. Refer to photos of the building's exterior and interior, and add a man greeting customers from behind the counter. 3D chibi-style miniature concept store of A SONG FOR YOU" <<> The café owner was very pleased but carefully requested, "Just... could you possibly remove the 'For Lease' sign?" <<> Of course, absolutely! <<> Following Gemini, I also created it with ChatGPT. <<> ChatGPT can do it all, too. Ah, but oh dear, I've used up too much energy. I'll be off now, quickly. <<> Lee Joo-hyun, Reporter, The Hankyoreh People and Digital Research Lab edigna@hani.co.kr (매주 목요일 저녁 파주 문발동 쩜오책방에서 열리는 강의 ‘곰토미의 AI 활용법’. 평소에도 활기있는 편이지만, 에이아이 이미지 만드는 법을 배운 23일엔 책방이 후끈 달아올랐습니다. 프로그램 개발자이자 영상 기획·제작자인 곰토미 이해범님이 카메라 렌즈·각도·조명·스타일 등 각종 프롬프트용 정보가 어마어마하게 담겨 있는 자료를 투척했거든요. ‘와, 이거 다 하다보면 지구가 녹겠는걸’ 하면서도 이주현, 한귀영 ‘사디랩’ 두 요원은 손을 멈출 수 없었죠.)

item.title: "What to do with my girlfriend?" Search and then book… Naver launches 'Conversational AI Search' (“여친이랑 뭐 하지?” 검색 후 예약까지…네이버 ‘대화형 AI 검색’ 출시)
item.description:
Naver introduced its artificial intelligence search service, the 'AI Tab', to Naver Plus membership users on the 28th. (네이버가 인공지능 검색 서비스인 ‘에이아이(AI) 탭’을 네이버플러스 멤버십 사용자를 대상으로 28일 선보인다.)

The newly unveiled 'AI Tab' is a conversational AI search service that comprehensively understands the user's search intent and context to provide optimized information. This service can understand and respond to a wide range of questions, from everyday queries to advanced information exploration. For instance, it can handle broad questions like 'What to do with my girlfriend tomorrow?' as well as complex requests such as 'Recommend a café in Seoul Gangnam that's good for studying, has power outlets, and has many reviews mentioning spacious seats,' by understanding the user's context. (이번에 새롭게 선보이는 ‘에이아이 탭’은 사용자의 검색 의도와 맥락을 입체적으로 이해해 최적화된 정보를 제공해주는 대화형 인공지능 검색 서비스다. 이 서비스는 일상적인 질문은 물론, 고도화된 정보 탐색까지 폭넓은 질문을 이해하고 답변할 수 있다. 가령, ‘내일 여자친구와 뭐할까’와 같은 포괄적인 질문은 물론, ‘서울 강남에서 공부하기 좋은 카페 중에 콘센트가 있고, 좌석이 넓다는 리뷰가 많은 곳을 추천해줘’ 등과 같은 복합적인 요청도 사용자 맥락을 이해해 답변한다.)

In particular, the AI Tab strengthens the connection between Naver's core services—such as integrated search, shopping, places, blogs, and cafes—allowing users to view necessary information on a single screen. For example, if you ask, 'Tell me a café near Hwadam Forest that's good for a date with a great view,' the AI Tab comprehensively analyzes café information from Naver Places, visitor reviews, and blog posts to provide information and even proceed with reservations. If you ask something like, 'Recommend a refrigerator with many reviews on wedding preparation cafes,' it will recommend products based on Naver café reviews, and on the right side of the screen, you can check purchase benefits and delivery details to proceed directly with a purchase. (특히 에이아이 탭은 통합검색·쇼핑·플레이스·블로그·카페, 등 네이버 핵심 서비스 간의 연결을 강화해 필요한 정보를 한 화면에서 확인할 수 있도록 지원한다. 예컨대 ‘화담 숲 근처 데이트하기 좋고 뷰가 좋은 카페 알려줘’라고 질문하면, 에이아이 탭은 네이버 플레이스에 있는 카페 정보와 방문자 리뷰, 블로그 후기를 종합 분석해 정보를 제공하고, 예약까지 진행한다. ‘결혼 준비 카페에서 후기 많이 올라온 냉장고 추천해줘’와 같은 질문을 할 경우, 네이버 카페 후기를 중심으로 제품을 추천하고, 답변을 제공한 화면 우측에선 구매 혜택과 배송 등의 상세 정보를 확인해 바로 구매까지 진행할 수 있다.)

Currently, the AI Tab can be experienced through the Naver PC main search bar, the bottom of the AI briefing, and integrated search results for shopping and places. However, the current feature is a beta (test) version. Naver plans to expand its application to all users and the mobile main search bar within the first half of this year. By the end of the year, a multimodal AI search feature linking the AI Tab with Smart Lens will also be added. (현재는 네이버 피시(PC) 메인 검색창과 인공지능 브리핑 하단, 쇼핑·플레이스 통합검색 결과 등을 통해 에이아이 탭을 경험할 수 있다. 다만, 현재 기능은 베타(시험용) 버전이다. 네이버는 올해 상반기 내에 전체 사용자 및 모바일 메인 검색창에서도 이를 활용할 수 있도록 적용을 확대할 예정이다. 연내에는 에이아이 탭과 스마트렌즈를 연계한 멀티모달 (다중 양식) 인공지능 검색 기능도 추가된다.)

Naver CEO Choi Soo-yeon said, "The AI Tab is a turning point in Naver's search paradigm, naturally expanding from exploration to execution," and added, "By strengthening connections with vertical services such as shopping and local, we will provide a differentiated AI search experience in daily life and ultimately aim for an integrated agent that leads to execution." (최수연 네이버 대표는 “에이아이 탭은 탐색에서 실행으로 자연스럽게 확장되는 네이버 검색 패러다임의 전환점”이라며 “쇼핑, 로컬 등 버티컬 서비스와의 연결을 강화해 일상 속 차별화된 에이아이 검색 경험을 제공하며, 궁극적으로 실행까지 연결되는 통합 에이전트를 지향해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Kang Jae-gu j9@hani.co.kr (강재구 기자 j9@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Gwangju autonomous driving participant companies: Hyundai Motor, AutonomouSA2Z, RideFlux (광주 자율주행 참여 기업에…현대차·오토노머스에이투지·라이드플럭스)
item.description:
Hyundai Motor, AutonomouSA2Z, and RideFlux have been selected as three companies to participate in the Gwangju autonomous driving demonstration city. (광주 자율주행 실증도시 참여 기업으로 현대자동차, 오토노머스에이투지, 라이드플럭스 3곳이 선정됐다.)

The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced on the 28th that it has selected the above three companies to participate in the development of end-to-end (E2E) AI autonomous driving technology in Gwangju, which was designated as the first autonomous driving demonstration city in the country. End-to-end autonomous driving is a technology that processes the processes of autonomous driving, such as perception, judgment, and control, through a single AI neural network. (국토교통부는 국내 첫 자율주행 실증도시로 지정된 광주에서 엔드투엔드(E2E) 인공지능 자율주행 기술 개발에 참여할 기업으로 위 3개 업체를 선정했다고 28일 밝혔다. 엔드투엔드 자율주행이란 인지·판단·제어 같은 자율주행 작동 과정을 하나의 인공지능 신경망으로 처리하는 기술이다.)

Previously, the government designated the entire city of Gwangju as an autonomous driving demonstration space, aiming for the commercialization of Level 4 autonomous driving (a level where autonomous driving is possible without driver intervention in specific areas or conditions) starting next year. The selected companies will be differentially allocated a total of 200 dedicated vehicles and will conduct technology development based on demonstrations on roads and residential areas throughout Gwangju. (앞서 정부는 내년 자율주행 레벨4(특정 구역이나 조건에서 운전자 개입 없이 자율주행이 가능한 수준) 상용화를 목표로 광주 전체를 자율주행 실증공간으로 지정한 바 있다. 이번에 선정된 기업은 전용 차량 총 200대를 차등 배분받아 광주 전역의 도로와 주택가 실증을 토대로 기술개발을 하게 된다.)

Hyundai Motor, selected on this day, is simultaneously developing Level 2+ (a level of driving assistance where the driver can take their hands off the steering wheel under specific conditions) for general consumers and Level 4 for commercial use. Meanwhile, AutonomouSA2Z is recognized for its capabilities in manufacturing driverless autonomous shuttles, having operated autonomous buses in 14 local governments. RideFlux is currently conducting the first demonstration of a completely unmanned autonomous vehicle in South Korea. (이날 선정된 현대차는 일반 소비자 대상 레벨2+(특정 조건에서 운전대에 손을 뗄 수 있는 수준의 주행보조)와 사업용 레벨4를 동시 개발하고 있으며, 오토노머스에이투지는 14개 지방정부에서 자율주행 버스를 운영하는 등 운전석 없는 자율주행셔틀의 제작 역량을 갖췄다고 평가받는다. 라이드플럭스는 국내 최초 무인 자율주행차 실증을 진행 중이다.)

The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport announced that it will create a regulatory exception environment and link support packages in finance, taxation, and other areas to realize the "AI autonomous vehicle mega-cluster" in Gwangju. Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport Kim Yoon-deok stated, "We will do our utmost, staking the ministry's fate, to ensure that the demonstration city is reborn as a hub leading South Korea’s core future strategic industries." (국토부는 광주에서 ‘인공지능 자율주행차 메가특구’를 구현하기 위해 규제 특례 환경을 조성하고 재정·금융·세제 등 지원 패키지를 연계하겠다고 밝혔다. 김윤덕 국토부 장관은 “국토부 명운을 걸고 실증도시가 대한민국 핵심 미래 전략산업을 이끄는 거점으로 거듭날 수 있도록 최선을 다하겠다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Shin Min-jung shin@hani.co.kr (신민정 기자 shin@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Fair Trade Commission Extends Corrective Measures for Hanwha-Former Daewoo Shipbuilding Merger by Three Years (공정위, 한화·옛 대우조선 기업결합 시정조치 3년 연장)
item.description:
The Fair Trade Commission (FTC) has decided to extend by three years the corrective measures imposed as a condition for approving Hanwha Group's acquisition of the former Daewoo Shipbuilding & Marine Engineering (now Hanwha Ocean). (공정거래위원회가 한화그룹의 옛 대우조선해양(한화오션) 인수를 승인하는 조건으로 부과했던 시정조치를 3년 연장하기로 했다.)

On the 28th, the FTC announced that it would extend the implementation period of the corrective measures imposed as conditions for the business combination approval among Hanwha Aerospace, Hanwha Systems, and Hanwha Ocean by three years. This marks the first time the FTC has extended the implementation period of behavioral corrective measures (which limit business terms, methods, scope, or internal management activities) following a business combination review. (공정위는 28일 한화에어로스페이스, 한화시스템 및 한화오션 간 기업결합 승인의 조건으로 부과된 시정조치의 이행 기간을 3년 연장한다고 밝혔다. 공정위가 기업결합 심사에 따른 행태적 시정조치(영업 조건·방식·범위 또는 내부 경영활동 등을 일정하게 제한하는 시정조치) 이행 기간을 연장한 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

Earlier, in May 2023, the FTC imposed corrective measures, judging that the business combination could restrict competition in the bidding process for naval vessels, including surface combatants and submarines. Hanwha was a monopolist or a leading player in each naval component market, while Daewoo Shipbuilding was the second-largest player in the domestic surface combatant market and the overwhelming leader in the submarine market. The FTC considered that Hanwha was at risk of providing Daewoo Shipbuilding with discriminatory information on naval components compared to competitors or submitting discriminatory quotes during the naval bidding process. It also determined that Hanwha might provide Daewoo Shipbuilding with trade secrets obtained from its competitors during the bidding process. (앞서 2023년 5월 공정위는 이들의 기업결합이 수상함, 잠수함 등 함정 입찰 과정에서 경쟁을 제한할 수 있다고 보고 시정조치를 부과한 바 있다. 한화는 각 함정 부품 시장에서 독점이거나 유력한 사업자였고, 대우조선은 국내 수상함 시장에서 2위, 잠수함 시장에서 압도적인 1위 사업자였다. 공정위는 한화가 대우조선에 함정 부품에 대해 경쟁사업자에 견줘 차별적인 정보를 주거나 함정 입찰 과정에서 차별적인 견적을 제시할 우려가 있다고 봤다 . 입찰 과정에서 한화가 경쟁사업자로부터 얻은 영업비밀을 대우조선에 줄 가능성도 있다고 판단했다.)

Accordingly, the FTC decided to prohibit Hanwha from unfairly and differentially providing quotation prices for naval components in ten component markets where Hanwha's market share exceeds 50%. It also banned Hanwha from unjustly refusing requests from Daewoo Shipbuilding's competitors for technical information on naval components through the Defense Acquisition Program Administration, as well as from providing trade secrets obtained from competitors to Daewoo Shipbuilding. At the time, the FTC required these corrective measures to be complied with for three years, with a decision on extension to be made after that period. (이에 따라 공정위는 한화의 시장점유율이 50%를 넘는 10개 함정 부품 시장에 대해 함정 부품의 견적 가격을 부당하게 차별적으로 제공하는 것을 금지하기로 했다. 대우조선의 경쟁사업자가 방위사업청을 통해 함정 부품의 기술정보를 요청했을 때 부당하게 거절하거나, 경쟁사업자로부터 얻은 영업비밀을 대우조선에 주는 것도 금지했다. 당시 공정위는 이 같은 시정조치를 3년간 준수하도록 하고, 3년 뒤 연장 여부를 결정하기로 한 바 있다.)

Regarding the decision to extend the corrective measures, the FTC explained, "We determined that the concerns about restricting competition have not been resolved." According to the FTC's analysis of the relevant market competition situation over the past three years (2023–2025), Hanwha Ocean remains a strong leader in both the surface combatant and submarine markets, while Hanwha Aerospace or Hanwha Systems are still monopolists or leading players in eight of the ten naval component markets. However, for the two component markets where concerns about competitive restriction have been alleviated due to the entry of new players, the implementation of corrective measures will be concluded. (공정위는 시정조치를 연장하기로 결정한 이유에 대해 “경쟁제한 우려가 해소되지 않은 것으로 봤다”고 설명했다. 공정위가 최근 3년(2023~2025년) 동안의 관련 시장 경쟁 상황을 분석한 결과, 한화오션은 수상함 및 잠수함 시장에서 모두 유력한 1위 사업자이고 한화에어로스페이스 또는 한화시스템은 10개 함정 부품 중 8개 시장에서 여전히 독점 또는 1위 사업자라는 것이다. 다만 신규 사업자의 진입 등으로 경쟁 제한 우려가 해소된 2개 부품 시장에 대해서는 시정조치 이행을 종결하도록 했다.)

The FTC has arranged that after three years, it will review the market competition environment and changes in relevant laws and systems again, allowing for an additional extension of the corrective measures for up to two more years. (공정위는 3년 뒤 시장 경쟁 환경, 관련 법·제도의 변화 등을 다시 검토해 최대 2년까지 시정조치를 추가 연장할 수 있도록 했다.)

Reporter Kim Yoon-ju kyj@hani.co.kr (김윤주 기자 kyj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Mortgage rates rise despite base rate freeze… hitting a 2-year, 4-month high (기준금리 동결 속 주담대 금리 상승세…2년4개월 만에 최고)
item.description:
Even with the base rate held steady, mortgage loan rates at banks continued to climb, reaching their highest level in two years and four months. (기준금리 동결 속에서도 은행권의 주택담보대출 금리는 오름세를 이어가며 2년4개월 만에 가장 높은 수준을 기록했다.)

According to the Bank of Korea’s “Weighted Average Interest Rates of Financial Institutions for March” report released on the 28th, the mortgage loan rate for household loans based on new disbursements at deposit-taking banks rose by 0.02 percentage points from the previous month to an annual rate of 4.34%. The mortgage loan rate at deposit-taking banks has been on an upward trend since January (4.29%) and recorded its highest level since November 2023 (4.48%). (한국은행이 28일 내놓은 ‘3월 중 금융기관 가중평균 금리’ 조사 자료를 보면, 신규 취급액 기준 예금은행의 가계대출 중 주택담보대출 금리는 전달보다 0.02%p 오른 연 4.34%로 나타났다. 예금은행 주담대 대출금리는 1월(4.29%) 이후 오름세를 이어가고 있으며 2023년 11월(4.48%) 이후 가장 높은 수준을 기록했다.)

The rise in mortgage loan rates is attributed to geopolitical instability from conflicts involving the U.S., Israel, and Iran, as well as financial authorities’ moves to tighten lending regulations. Lee Hye-young, head of the BOK’s Financial Statistics Team, also cited “the increase in the five-year bank bond rate, a benchmark rate.” According to data from the Korea Federation of Banks and the Korea Financial Investment Association, the five-year bank bond (AAA) rate rose from 3.58% in January to 3.73% in February and 3.90% in March, continuing its upward trend. (주담대 대출 금리 상승세는 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁에 따른 지정학적 불안정, 금융당국의 대출 규제 강화 움직임 때문으로 풀이된다. 이혜영 한은 금융통계팀장은 여기에 “지표금리인 은행채 5년물 상승”을 들었다. 은행연합회·금융투자협회 집계 은행채(AAA) 5년물 금리는 1월 3.58%, 2월 3.73%, 3월 3.90%로 오름세를 이어왔다.)

Overall loan rates showed a decline, dropping by 0.06 percentage points from the previous month to 4.20%. This was driven by a downward trend in corporate loan rates. Corporate loan rates fell by 0.06 percentage points from the previous month to 4.14%. Both large corporations (-0.02 percentage points) and small and medium-sized enterprises (-0.11 percentage points) saw declines. The BOK attributed this to “support through preferential interest rates to expand corporate credit.” (대출 금리 전반적으로는 내림세를 보여 전달보다 0.06%p 하락한 4.20%로 나타났다. 이는 기업대출 하락세에 바탕을 두고 있다. 기업대출 금리는 전달보다 0.06%p 떨어진 4.14%를 기록했다. 대기업(-0.02%p), 중소기업(-0.11%p) 모두 떨어졌다. 한은은 “기업 여신 확대를 위한 우대금리 지원”을 배경으로 풀이했다.)

For household loans, not only mortgage loans but also general credit loans rose by 0.04 percentage points from the previous month to 5.57%. Overall household loans increased by 0.06 percentage points to 4.34%. (가계대출 금리는 주담대뿐 아니라 일반 신용대출도 전달보다 0.04%p 올라 5.57%를 기록했다. 가계대출 전반은 0.06%p 오른 4.34%로 나타났다.)

The proportion of fixed-rate household loans dropped from 43.1% in the previous month to 35.5%. This is the lowest level since September 2022 (33.6%), and the BOK analyzed that it resulted from a decrease in the disbursement of fixed-rate mortgage loans and fixed-rate jeonse loans. The share of fixed-rate mortgage loans fell by 10.3 percentage points from the previous month to 60.8%. (가계대출의 고정금리 비중은 전달 43.1%에서 35.5%로 떨어졌다. 2022년 9월(33.6%) 이후 최저치이며, 고정형 주택담보대출 및 고정형 전세대출 취급 비중이 모든 감소한 결과라고 한은은 분석했다. 고정형 주담대 비중은 전달보다 10.3%p 하락한 60.8%를 기록했다.)

The savings deposit rate at deposit-taking banks, based on new disbursements, fell by 0.01 percentage points from the previous month to 2.82%, due to declines in time deposit rates. The market-type financial product rate also dropped by 0.01 percentage points to 2.79%. Unlike the banking sector, deposit rates (based on one-year maturity time deposits) at non-bank financial institutions all rose. The increases were: savings banks by 0.17 percentage points, credit unions by 0.14 percentage points, mutual finance companies by 0.09 percentage points, and Community Credit Cooperatives by 0.16 percentage points. Lending rates (based on general loans) fell at savings banks and Community Credit Cooperatives, while rising at credit unions and mutual finance companies. (예금은행의 신규취급액 기준 저축성 수신금리는 정기예금 금리 등의 하락으로 전달보다 0.01%p 떨어진 2.82%를 기록했다. 시장형 금융상품 금리도 0.01%p 하락한 2.79%로 나타났다. 은행권과 달리 비은행금융기관의 수신금리(1년만기 정기예탁금 기준)는 모두 상승했다. 상승 폭은 저축은행 0.17%p, 신협 0.14%p, 상호금융 0.09%p, 새마을금고 0.16%p였다. 대출금리(일반대출 기준)는 저축은행과 새마을금고는 하락하고, 신협과 상호금융은 상승했다.)

Senior Reporter Kim Young-bae kimyb@hani.co.kr (김영배 선임기자 kimyb@hani.co.kr)
